subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Use clocks to calculate the length of time in hours and half hours

show.line: The show starts at two o'clock and ends at four o'clock. Two, three, four. It lasts two hours!

rounds.prompt: Soccer starts at three o'clock and ends at five o'clock. How long is that?
Lunch starts at twelve o'clock and ends at half past twelve. How long is lunch?
School starts at eight o'clock. It ends at one o'clock. How many hours? Say the number.
The bus leaves at ten o'clock. The trip takes one hour. Which clock shows when it arrives?
rounds.praise: Eleven o'clock! One hour after ten.

rounds.story: Nomsa starts reading at six o'clock. She reads for half an hour. What time does she stop?

rounds.prompt: Which takes longer, one hour or half an hour?
rounds.praise: Yes! One hour is longer than half an hour.

hints: Count the hours from the start time to the end time.
From o'clock to half past is half an hour.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! The party starts at one o'clock and ends at three o'clock.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One, two, three. The party lasts three hours!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Count the jumps, not the numbers. One to two, two to three. Two hours.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count the jumps together. One to two, two to three. Two hours!

parent_line: Can work out how long something takes in hours and half hours.
